tldr: Venus through the 11th house brings focus to friends, networks, community, hopes, and collective work.
body: Venus transiting the 11th house softens friends, networks, community, hopes, and collective work. For about three to four weeks, ease, attraction, value, pleasure, and relational support move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a receiving transit: it can bring support, pleasure, repair, and opportunities to value this area with more grace.
business: Venus supports community contribution and future goals: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Avoidance, indulgence, people-pleasing, or belonging without discernment.
advice: Receive and refine in the 11th house deliberately. Work with friends, networks, community, hopes, and collective work without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from approved project house-transit material.
